mechanism: Both drugs can cause neurotoxicity and renal impairment; gabapentin is renally cleared and zoledronic acid can reduce glomerular filtration rate, leading to gabapentin accumulation.
action: Monitor renal function closely; adjust gabapentin dosing based on creatinine clearance; assess for neurotoxic symptoms (dizziness, confusion, ataxia) and ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusion.
